message.field_arcana.staff.no_core: Hold a Field Core in your other hand to choose a field
tooltip.field_arcana.core.gravis: Universal attraction. Everything carries Gravis charge equal to its mass.
tooltip.field_arcana.core.fulgur: Like charges repel. Strong fields break down through charged bodies.
tooltip.field_arcana.core.nexus: Short-ranged binding. Space inside becomes viscous.
tooltip.field_arcana.core.mutatio: Contact field. Opens matter to transmutation; other fields decide the product.
tooltip.field_arcana.staff.mode_hint.emi: Places a positive source where you look
Places a negative source where you look
tooltip.field_arcana.staff.mode_hint.imb: Induces positive charge on a creature (or yourself)
Induces negative charge on a creature (or yourself)
tooltip.field_arcana.staff.mode_hint.len: Amplifies the field ×3 where you look
tooltip.field_arcana.staff.usage: Use: cast with the core in your other hand · Sneak+Use: switch mode
tooltip.field_arcana.lens.usage: Hold to see field lines · Use: choose the field
